enDef: a large animal of the cat family that lives in Africa and parts of southern Asia. Lions have gold-coloured fur and the male has a mane(= long hair around its neck ).

example.en: So they sent me a… lion!
example.cn: 于是他们又送我一头…狮子！

enDef: towards the direction or side that is on the left

example.en: Turn left just after the school.
example.cn: 过了那所学校马上左转。

enDef: to make sounds with your voice, usually while you are smiling, because you think something is funny

example.en: Maria looked at him and laughed.
example.cn: 玛丽亚看着他大笑起来。

enDef: to write a list, or mention things one after the other

example.en: The guidebook lists 1,000 hotels and restaurants.
example.cn: 旅游手册上列有1,000家宾馆和餐厅。

cn: [lent-lent] 把…借给， 出借； 贷
enDef: to let someone borrow money or something that belongs to you for a short time

example.en: The bank is reassessing its criteria for lending money.
example.cn: 银行正在重新评估其贷款标准。

cn: 女士， 小姐； 举止文雅的女子， 淑女
enDef: a woman who is polite and behaves very well

example.en: She knows how to behave like a lady.
example.cn: 她知道怎么做一个淑女。

cn: 爱的； 充满爱的；  钟爱的
enDef: behaving in a way that shows you love someone

example.en: What that child needs is plenty of loving care .
example.cn: 那孩子所需要的是大量的关爱。

cn: 活的；生动的；实况转播的；精力充沛的
enDef: not dead or artificial

example.en: experiments on live animals
example.cn: 动物活体实验

enDef: a large area of water surrounded by land

example.en: Lake Michigan
example.cn: 密歇根湖

enDef: a laboratory

example.en: the school science lab
example.cn: 学校的科学实验室

cn: 腰以下到膝为止的大腿部； 一圈； 一段旅程
enDef: the upper part of your legs when you are sitting down

example.en: Rubens Barrichello finished a lap ahead of his team-mate.
example.cn: 鲁本斯·巴里切罗领先队友一圈跑完全程。

cn: 法律， 法规； 法学； 律师行业； 规律， 法则
enDef: the whole system of rules that people in a particular country or area must obey

example.en: Elected officials ought to obey the law.
example.cn: 民选官员理应遵守法律。

cn: 放置， 放下； 铺， 砌； 下， 产； 设置， 布置； 使处于
enDef: to put someone or something down carefully into a flat position

example.en: He laid his hand on my shoulder.
example.cn: 他把一只手搭在我的肩上。

enDef: not so much or to a smaller degree

example.en: Maybe he would worry less if he understood the situation.
example.cn: 他要是了解情况，也许就不会那么担心了。

cn: 靠岸， 登陆； 降落
enDef: if a plane, bird, or insect lands, it moves safely down onto the ground

example.en: Flight 846 landed five minutes ago.
example.cn: 846次航班五分钟之前降落了。

enDef: an object that produces light by using electricity, oil, or gas

example.en: She switched on the bedside lamp.
example.cn: 她打开了床头灯。

cn: 羔羊， 小羊； 羔羊肉
enDef: a young sheep

example.en: roast lamb
example.cn: 烤羊肉

cn: 腿， 腿部； 腿， 支柱
enDef: one of the long parts of your body that your feet are joined to, or a similar part on an animal or insect

example.en: a young boy with skinny legs
example.cn: 双腿干瘦的小男孩

cn: [let-let]　允许， 让； 假设； 出租； 排放
enDef: to allow someone to do something

example.en: I can’t come out tonight – my dad won’t let me.
example.cn: 今天晚上我不能出来，我爸爸不允许。

enDef: if a town, village, etc lies in a particular place, it is in that place

example.en: The town lies in a small wooded valley.
example.cn: 该城镇坐落于一个林木茂盛的山谷中。

cn: 信；字母，文字；证书；文学，学问；字面意义
enDef: a written or printed message that is usually put in an envelope and sent by mail

example.en: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet.
example.cn: 英语字母表有26个字母。

enDef: the most recent or the newest

example.en: all the latest gossip
example.cn: 最近所有的流言蜚语

cn: 迟的， 晚的； 末期的， 晚期的； 最近的， 新近的； 已故的； 以前的
enDef: arriving, happening, or done after the time that was expected, agreed, or arranged

example.en: Sorry I’m late – I overslept.
example.cn: 对不起，来晚了——我睡过头了。

cn: 长时间；[语] 长音节；（服装的）长尺寸；长裤
enDef: measuring a great length from one end to the other

example.en: a long table
example.cn: 一张长桌子

cn: 刚过去的， 紧接前面的； 最后的， 最后剩下的； 最不可能的， 最不合适
enDef: The last event, person, thing, or period of time is the most recent one

example.en: Much has changed since my last visit.
example.cn: 自我上次来访后，变化很大。

enDef: the way a person or group of people live, including the place they live in, the things they own, the kind of job they do, and the activities they enjoy

example.en: Regular exercise is part of a healthy lifestyle.
example.cn: 经常锻炼身体是健康生活方式的一部分。

cn: 孤独的， 寂寞的； 荒凉的， 人迹稀少的
enDef: unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone to talk to

example.en: a lonely old man
example.cn: 一个孤单的老人

cn: 课； 教学单元； 一堂课， 一节课； 教训， 经验
enDef: a period of time in which someone is taught a particular skill, for example how to play a musical instrument or drive a car

example.en: piano lessons
example.cn: 钢琴课

cn: 光线充足的， 明亮的； 淡
enDef: a light colour is pale and not dark

example.en: You look nice in light colours.
example.cn: 你穿浅色衣服很好看。

cn: 懒惰的， 懒散的； 慢吞吞的
enDef: not liking work and physical activity, or not making any effort to do anything

example.en: the laziest boy in the class
example.cn: 班上最懒的男孩

cn: 许多， 大量； 签， 抽签； 一块地， 场地
enDef: a large amount or number

example.en: We’ve spent a lot on the children’s education.
example.cn: 我们在孩子的教育上花费甚多。

cn: 低的， 矮的； 低下的， 低等的； 粗劣的， 低俗的； 不充分的， 缺乏的； 意气
enDef: bad, or below an acceptable or usual level or quality

example.en: Their safety standards seem to be pretty low.
example.cn: 他们的安全标准似乎相当低。

enDef: to give official permission for someone to do or produce something, or for an activity to take place

example.en: No special license will be regranted to anyone from now on.
example.cn: 特殊许可证今后不得向任何人再行发放。

enDef: to pay attention to what someone is saying or to a sound that you can hear

example.en: Listen! There’s a strange noise in the engine.
example.cn: 听！引擎发出奇怪的声音。

enDef: the person who directs or controls a group, organization, country etc

example.en: the largest ever gathering of world leaders
example.cn: 全世界领导人史无前例的大聚会

cn: 大声的，高声的；不断的；喧吵的
enDef: making a lot of noise

example.en: The book fell to the floor with a loud bang.
example.cn: 书砰的一声掉落到地上。

enDef: having good luck

example.en: I didn’t really know your name – it was just a lucky guess .
example.cn: 我并不知道你的名字―只是运气好猜中的。

enDef: after the time you are talking about or after the present time

example.en: I’m going out for a bit – I’ll see you later.
example.cn: 我出去一会儿——回头见。

cn: 警戒， 监视； ■望台， 监视哨； ■望员， 监视者； 与个人有关的事情， 任务
enDef: someone whose duty is to watch carefully for something, especially for danger

example.en: We’re always on the lookout for new business opportunities.
example.cn: 我们一直在留意，等待新的商机。

cn: 可爱的；令人愉快的；爱恋的；秀丽的，优美的
enDef: beautiful or attractive

example.en: She had a lovely face.
example.cn: 她有一张漂亮的脸蛋。

enDef: a meal eaten in the middle of the day

example.en: What’s for lunch?
example.cn: 午饭吃什么？

enDef: to fasten something, usually with a key, so that other people cannot open it, or to be fastened like this （

example.en: Did you lock the car?
example.cn: 你把汽车锁好了吗？

enDef: the amount or degree of something, compared to another amount or degree

example.en: Inflation fell to its lowest level in 30 years.
example.cn: 通货膨胀降至30年来最低点。

cn: 运气；幸运；带来好运的东西
enDef: good things that happen to you by chance

example.en: You’re not having much luck today, are you?
example.cn: 你今天运气不太好，是不是？

cn: 垃圾；轿，担架；一窝（动物的幼崽）；凌乱
enDef: waste paper, cans etc that people have thrown away and left on the ground in a public place

example.en: People who drop litter can be fined in some cities.
example.cn: 在有些城市，乱扔垃圾的人会被罚款。

cn: 语言；语言文字；表达能力
enDef: a system of communication by written or spoken words, which is used by the people of a particular country or area

example.en: How many languages do you speak?
example.cn: 你能说几种语言？

enDef: big in size, amount, or number

example.en: Los Angeles is the second largest city in the US.
example.cn: 洛杉矶是美国的第二大城市。

enDef: if someone follows someone else’s lead, they do the same as the other person has done

example.en: Other countries are likely to follow the U.S.’s lead.
example.cn: 其他国家很可能会效法美国。

cn: 叶子；（书籍等的）一张；扇页
enDef: one of the flat green parts of a plant that are joined to its stem or branches

example.en: a flowering bush with large shiny leaves
example.cn: 叶子大而油亮的开花灌木

enDef: to gain knowledge of a subject or skill, by experience, by studying it, or by being taught

example.en: What’s the best way to learn a language?
example.cn: 学习语言的最佳方法是什么？

cn: 最小的；最少的（little的最高级）
enDef: You use the least to mean a smaller amount than anyone or anything else, or the smallest amount possible

example.en: I try to offend the least amount of people possible.
example.cn: 我尽可能少得罪人。

enDef: a sweet fizzy drink that tastes of lemons

example.en: a glass of lemonade
example.cn: 一杯柠檬汽水

enDef: a room or building containing books that can be looked at or borrowed

example.en: a public library
example.cn: 公共图书馆

cn: 举起；提升；鼓舞；空运；抄袭
enDef: to move something or someone upwards into the air

example.en: Sophie lifted the phone before the second ring.
example.cn: 铃响了一下苏菲就接起了电话。

enDef: to enjoy something or think that it is nice or good

example.en: I like your jacket.
example.cn: 我喜欢你这件上衣。

enDef: a long thin mark on a piece of paper, the ground, or another surface

example.en: Draw a straight line across the top of the page.
example.cn: 在这一页的上方画一条直线。

cn: 活泼的；生动的；真实的；生气勃勃的
enDef: someone who is lively has a lot of energy and is very active

example.en: a lively child
example.cn: 精力充沛的孩子

example.en: He was nursed in London.
example.cn: 他是在伦敦长大的。

cn: 看；期待；注意；面向；看上去像
enDef: to turn your eyes towards something, so that you can see it

example.en: We sneaked out while Jessie’s mom wasn’t looking.
example.cn: 我们趁杰茜的妈妈没有看到，偷偷地溜了出去。

cn: 恋爱；亲爱的；酷爱；喜爱的事物；爱情，爱意；疼爱；热爱；爱人，所爱之物
enDef: a strong feeling of liking someone a lot combined with sexual attraction

example.en: Tara is madly in love with you.
example.cn: 塔拉疯狂地爱着你。

example.en: I should assign you your share of labor, and compel you to accomplish it.
example.cn: 我要把属于你的那份劳动分配给你，并且强迫你完成它。

enDef: a special room or building in which a scientist does tests or prepares substances

example.en: a research laboratory
example.cn: 研究实验室

cn: 失去的， 丧失的； 错过的； 迷惑的
enDef: if you are lost, you do not know where you are and are unable to find your way somewhere

example.en: ‘Are you lost?’ the driver asked.
example.cn: “你迷路了吗？”司机问道。

cn: [lost-lost] 失去， 损失； 迷失， 使迷路； 输， 输掉； 白费， 浪费； 走慢
enDef: to stop having a particular attitude, quality, ability etc, or to gradually have less of it

example.en: I’ve lost my appetite.
example.cn: 我已经没有了胃口。

cn: 照明； 照明设备； 光线
enDef: the lights that light a room, building, or street, or the quality of the light produced

example.en: Better street lighting might help to reduce crime.
example.cn: 改善街道照明或许有助于减少犯罪。

cn: [left-left] 离开， 出发； 留下， 遗留； 遗忘； 听任， 让； 交托， 委托
enDef: to go away from a place or a person

example.en: My baby gets upset when I leave the room.
example.cn: 我一离开房间宝宝就会不安。

cn: 地方性的，本地的；局部的；狭隘的
enDef: relating to the particular area you live in, or the area you are talking about

example.en: local hospital
example.cn: 当地医院

enDef: an old, well-known story, often about brave people, adventures, or magical events

example.en: Local legend has it that (= says that ) the island was the original Garden of Eden.
example.cn: 当地传说这个岛就是伊甸园的原型。

cn: 小的， 矮小的； 短的； 琐碎的， 微不足道的； 不多的， 少到
enDef: small in size

example.en: a little house
example.cn: 小屋

cn: 生命， 性命； 一生， 寿命； 生活， 生存； 人生； 生物； 生气， 活力
enDef: the period of time when someone is alive

example.en: Learning goes on throughout life.
example.cn: 学习是一生的事。

enDef: a cover for the open part of a pot, box, or other container

example.en: keeping the lid on inflation
example.cn: 控制通货膨胀

enDef: best, most important, or most successful

example.en: The army played a leading role in organizing the attempted coup.
example.cn: 军队在策划这场未遂政变的过程中起了最主要的作用。

enDef: the cases, bags etc that you carry when you are travelling

example.en: They searched his luggage for illegal drugs.
example.cn: 他们搜查他的行李看是否藏有毒品。

enDef: when there is not enough of something, or none of it

example.en: Too many teachers are treated with a lack of respect.
example.cn: 有太多老师得不到尊重。

enDef: a lamp that you can carry, consisting of a metal container with glass sides that surrounds a flame or light

example.en: They pant after liberation.
example.cn: 他们渴望解放。

cn: 法律的；合法的；法定的；依照法律的
enDef: if something is legal, you are allowed to do it or have to do it by law

example.en: What the company has done is perfectly legal.
example.cn: 公司所做的这一切完全合法。

cn: 残留物；吃剩的饭菜；剩余物
enDef: food that has not been eaten at the end of a meal

example.en: Give the leftovers to the dog.
example.cn: 把吃剩的饭菜喂狗。

enDef: unable to walk properly because your leg or foot is injured or weak

example.en: a lame dog
example.cn: 一条瘸腿的狗

enDef: the freedom and the right to do whatever you want without asking permission or being afraid of authority

example.en: the fight for liberty and equality
example.cn: 争取自由和平等的斗争

enDef: to free prisoners, a city, a country etc from someone’s control

example.en: A few days later, our armies liberated the city.
example.cn: 几天以后，我军解放了这座城市。

enDef: someone who works in a library

example.en: The new librarian is a friend of mine.
example.cn: 这位新来的图书管理员是我的朋友。

enDef: animal skin that has been treated to preserve it, and is used for making shoes, bags etc

example.en: The inside of the bag was lined with soft leather.
example.cn: 这包的里面衬了软皮。

enDef: books, plays, poems etc that people think are important and good

example.en: He has read many of the major works of literature.
example.cn: 他读过许多重要的文学作品。

enDef: a public room in a hotel or other building, that is used by many people as a place to relax

example.en: the television lounge
example.cn: 电视放映室

cn: 液体的；清澈的；明亮的；易变的
enDef: in the form of a liquid instead of a gas or solid

example.en: Children take antibiotics in liquid form.
example.cn: 儿童服用液态抗生素。

enDef: very fast, and often without warning

example.en: a lightning attack
example.cn: 闪电式突袭

example.en: We got a load of complaints about the loud music.
example.cn: 很多人向我们投诉音乐太响。

enDef: bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and can be cut into slices

example.en: a loaf of bread
example.cn: 一条面包

enDef: the measurement of how long something is from one end to the other

example.en: We measured the length and width of the living room.
example.cn: 我们量了客厅的长和宽。

cn: 洗衣店； 要洗的衣服
enDef: clothes, sheets etc that need to be washed or have just been washed

example.en: She did the laundry (= washed the clothes etc ) and hung it out to dry.
example.cn: 她洗了衣服，然后挂出去晾干。

cn: 宽松的；散漫的；不牢固的；不精确的
enDef: not firmly fastened in place

example.en: a loose floorboard
example.cn: 松动的地板

enDef: when people laugh, or the sound of people laughing

example.en: Foster joined in the laughter.
example.cn: 福斯特也跟着笑了起来。

enDef: one of the two soft parts around your mouth where your skin is redder or darker

example.en: She had big eyes and full lips (= large and round lips ).
example.cn: 她眼睛大大的，嘴唇很丰满。

enDef: the fact of no longer having something, or of having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens

example.en: The company is closing down two of its factories, leading to 430 job losses .
example.cn: 公司要关闭其中的两家工厂，这将造成430人失业。

cn: 后者的；近来的；后面的；较后的
enDef: being the second of two people or things, or the last in a list just mentioned

example.en: In the latter case, buyers pay a 15% commission.
example.cn: 在后一种情况下，买家付15%的佣金。

enDef: relating to literature

example.en: a literary prize
example.cn: 文学奖

enDef: pale yellow in colour

example.en: A lemon is an acid fruit.
example.cn: 柠檬是一种酸味水果。

enDef: work, especially physical work

example.en: The garage charges £30 an hour for labour.
example.cn: 汽车修理厂收取每小时30英镑的人工费。

cn: [计量] 公升（米制容量单位）
enDef: the basic unit for measuring liquid in the metric system

example.en: the Ford’s 2.8 litre engine
example.cn: 福特汽车2.8升排量的引擎

enDef: a small hole that lets liquid or gas flow into or out of something

example.en: There is a leak in the ceiling.
example.cn: 天花板上有条裂缝。

cn: （英）卡车；[车辆] 货车；运料车
enDef: a large vehicle for carrying heavy goods

example.en: Now and then they heard the roar of a heavy lorry.
example.cn: 他们不时听见一辆重型卡车的轰响声。

enDef: a piece of equipment used for climbing up to or down from high places. A ladder has two bars that are connected by rungs(= short bars that you use as steps ) .

example.en: She climbed up the ladder.
example.cn: 她爬上梯子。

enDef: a group of people or countries who have joined together because they have similar aims, political beliefs etc

example.en: the National Socialist League
example.cn: 国家社会主义联盟

enDef: someone whose work needs physical strength, for example building work

example.en: a farm labourer
example.cn: 农场工人

enDef: a piece of equipment that produces a powerful narrow beam of light that can be used in medical operations, to cut metals, or to make patterns of light for entertainment

example.en: laser surgery
example.cn: 激光(外科)手术

enDef: a toilet or the room a toilet is in

example.en: ...the ladies' lavatory.
example.cn: …女厕所。

enDef: someone whose job is to advise people about laws, write formal agreements, or represent people in court

example.en: Prosecution and defence lawyers are expected to deliver closing arguments next week.
example.cn: 原告律师和被告律师下周将要作终结辩论。

cn: 博学的；有学问的；学术上的
enDef: a learned person has a lot of knowledge because they have read and studied a lot

example.en: a learned professor
example.cn: 一位博学的教授

enDef: a long talk on a particular subject that someone gives to a group of people, especially to students in a university

example.en: ...a series of lectures by Professor Eric Robinson.
example.cn: …埃里克·鲁滨逊教授的系列讲座。

enDef: the period of time during which someone is alive or something exists

example.en: It’s the sort of opportunity you see only once in a lifetime.
example.cn: 这种机会你一辈子也只能碰到一次。

cn: 很可能的；合适的；有希望的
enDef: suitable for a particular purpose

example.en: the three most likely candidates for president
example.cn: 最有可能当选的三位总统候选人

enDef: the greatest or least amount, number, speed etc that is allowed

example.en: a 55 mph speed limit
example.cn: 55英里的时速限制

enDef: a way in which two things or ideas are related to each other

example.en: Send an email to the above address to report a broken link (= a link that is not working properly ).
example.cn: 如发现链接失败，请发送电子邮件至上述地址告知。

cn: 活的；现存的；活跃的；逼真的
enDef: alive now

example.en: He’s one of the greatest living composers.
example.cn: 他是仍然健在的最伟大的作曲家之一。

enDef: an insect that lives mainly in Asia and Africa and flies in a very large group, eating and destroying crops

example.en: a swarm of locusts

enDef: growing strongly and thickly

example.en: luxuriant black hair
example.cn: 浓密的黑发

cn: 做联络人； 联络， 联系
enDef: to exchange information with someone who works in another organization or department so that you can both be more effective

example.en: Detectives are liaising with police following the bomb explosion early today.
example.cn: 在今天早些时候炸弹爆炸之后侦探们就一直在联络警方。

cn: 向陆的/地， 近陆的/地

example.en: The more mixing that occurs in the estuary the greater is the landward flow in the subsurface layer.
example.cn: 在河口湾出现的混合越强烈，次表层向陆地方向的流量就越大。

enDef: continuing for a long period of time, or relating to what will happen in the distant future

example.en: the long-term future of the fishing industry
example.cn: 渔业的长远未来

cn: 立法的，有立法权的；根据法规执行的；立法机关的
enDef: concerned with making laws

example.en: The new assemblies will have no legislative power.
example.cn: 新的议会将没有立法权。

enDef: Leukaemia is a disease of the blood in which the body produces too many white blood cells

example.en: Can irritability purpura turn into leukaemia?
example.cn: 过敏性紫癜会转成白血病吗？

cn: 经度的， 经线的； 纵的； 长度的
enDef: relating to the development of something over a period of time

example.en: longitudinal stripes
example.cn: 竖直条纹

enDef: the way you earn money in order to live

example.en: It’s difficult to earn a livelihood as an artist.
example.cn: 搞艺术很难谋生。

enDef: heavily loaded with something, or containing a lot of something

example.en: snow-laden branches
example.cn: 积满雪的树枝

enDef: to express feelings of great sadness about something

example.en: The nation lamented the death of its great war leader.
example.cn: 举国上下都在哀悼他们伟大的战时领袖。

enDef: moving slowly and involving very little energy

example.en: He greeted Charles with a languid wave of his hand.
example.cn: 他无精打采地挥挥手，算是和查尔斯打招呼。

enDef: deserving praise, even if not completely successful

example.en: a laudable attempt
example.cn: 值得称道的尝试

enDef: hot liquid rock that flows from a volcano,or this rock when it has become solid

example.en: Mexico's Mount Colima began spewing lava and ash last night.
example.cn: 墨西哥科利马山昨晚开始喷发熔岩和火山灰。

enDef: large, impressive, or expensive

example.en: a royal palace on a lavish scale
example.cn: 庞大的皇宫

enDef: not strict or careful enough about standards of behaviour, work, safety etc

example.en: One of the problem areas is lax security for airport personnel.
example.cn: 其中一个问题是对机场人员的安全措施不严格。

enDef: animals such as cows and sheep that are kept on a farm

example.en: The heavy rains and flooding killed scores of livestock.
example.cn: 大雨和洪水淹死了许多家畜。

enDef: to be unwilling to do something

example.en: Sarah was loath to tell her mother what had happened.
example.cn: 萨拉不愿意告诉母亲所发生的事。

cn: 懒洋洋地倚靠,(头等)垂下n游手好闲的人"
enDef: to sit or lie in a very lazy and relaxed way

example.en: He was lolling on the sofa in the shadows near the fire.
example.cn: 他懒洋洋地躺在炉火边一个背光的沙发上。

example.en: Orin Hargraves is a lexicographer, someone who writes dictionaries. Hargraves explains what happened.
example.cn: 欧林·哈格雷夫斯是一名词典编纂者，也就是编字典的人。他解释了当时发生了什么。

cn: 对一侧面的偏重， 偏向一侧状态

enDef: to make a law about something

example.en: Most member countries have already legislated against excessive overtime.
example.cn: 大部分成员国已经立法禁止过度加班。

cn: 清楚的，易懂的，神智清醒的
enDef: expressed in a way that is clear and easy to understand

example.en: You must write in a clear and lucid style.
example.cn: 你的写作风格一定要清楚易懂。

enDef: a job or activity that is lucrative lets you earn a lot of money

example.en: Thousands of ex-army officers have found lucrative jobs in private security firms.
example.cn: 成千上万的退役军官在私人保安公司找到了薪水丰厚的工作。

enDef: completely unreasonable, stupid, or wrong

example.en: It is ludicrous to suggest that I was driving under the influence of alcohol.
example.cn: 说我酒后驾车，这真是太荒唐了。

enDef: a young insect with a soft tube-shaped body, which will later become an insect with wings

example.en: The eggs quickly hatch into larvae.
example.cn: 这些卵很快孵化成幼虫。

enDef: to make someone feel calm or as if they want to sleep

example.en: The hum of the tyres on the road lulled her to sleep.
example.cn: 一路上滚滚的车轮声使她昏昏欲睡。
